chris.49k: The new stretcher bearer gave his name as Hugo "Lucky" Chris. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.

A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Hugo "Lucky" Chris. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Hugo "Lucky" Chris watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

A bucket appeared above the Concord parapet at the Brickworks. Yann Pickles fired. Hugo "Lucky" Chris pulled the bucket down. Later a sign went up: 'Water costs enough already.' Mail came up the line with a letter for Hugo "Lucky" Chris. Hugo "Lucky" Chris read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Hugo "Lucky" Chris offered a biscuit for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity. Mail came up the line with a letter for Hugo "Lucky" Chris. Hugo "Lucky" Chris read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Hugo "Lucky" Chris wrote to a landlady who kept his room exactly as it was. He did not mention the shelling. He mentioned the stars.

Hugo "Lucky" Chris sorted the dressings by lamplight. When the next stretcher arrived, he could find everything without looking. Mail came up the line with a letter for Hugo "Lucky" Chris. Hugo "Lucky" Chris read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
d.riley9979: Gideon Riley came up with a draft of replacements on Day 15. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
daone101: Viktor "Crow" Daone took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Viktor "Crow" Daone stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Across from S-R1, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Viktor "Crow" Daone saw it. Isidor Shitsherlock was grazed. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Viktor "Crow" Daone wrote to a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-R1 and grazed Viktor "Crow" Daone's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Viktor Eisenblatter of the Hegemony (@kaliel.eisenblatter).
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Viktor "Crow" Daone is whole again, or near enough for the line.
Viktor "Crow" Daone caught a falling mug with his boot. Nobody could say if it was skill or luck, and he did not say either.
Viktor "Crow" Daone fixed the strap on Henrik "Smokes" Kobold's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.
dfault_niel: Tobias Niel left a landlady who kept his room exactly as it was behind in Wyvern Cross and came up the line with a stub of a pencil. The men noticed at once that he hates silence more than shelling.

A bullet hit Tobias Niel's belt buckle at R-C10 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Clement "Tin" Natakhtasha of the Concord (@natakhtasha). On Day 10, Blackwater Canal passed to the Hegemony. Tobias Niel wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

The wound on Tobias Niel's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter. Tobias Niel got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 707. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at R-C10 changed before the cheering ended. Tobias Niel shouldered another load.
Tobias Niel and the spotter took turns with the telescope for half a day, talking only in numbers. At the last number Tobias Niel fired. Clement "Tin" Natakhtasha was grazed.
Tobias Niel let the enemy fix the same sandbag three times. The fourth time, Clement "Tin" Natakhtasha was gravely wounded.
The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Tobias Niel asked if second helpings depended on the answer.
A muddy dog crawled into R-C10 through the wire. Tobias Niel gave it half his bread. It has not left his side since. The men call it Kaiser.
endless_sans_obssessed_: Marek "Brick" Obssessed reached M-F15 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.
Marek "Brick" Obssessed carried in little Weiss, who lied about his age to enlist. little Weiss kept asking whether his mother would be told.
happy_hopper06: At the depot, Yann Hopper had practised answering to his name. At V-F13, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate. Yann Hopper transferred to the signallers. The men in V-F13 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Yann Hopper read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

The gas alarm sounded during supper. Yann Hopper put the bread down carefully and did not finish it until the all-clear. Mail came up the line with a letter for Yann Hopper. Yann Hopper read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A flare lit Blackwater Canal like noon. Yann Hopper counted the seconds until darkness: eleven. Mail came up the line with a letter for Yann Hopper. Yann Hopper read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Yann Hopper crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at V-F13 holds again. Mail came up the line with a letter for Yann Hopper. Yann Hopper read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Yann Hopper saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards. Mail came up the line with a letter for Yann Hopper. Yann Hopper read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
itswangz_007: Day 9: Roland "Whistle" Itswangz reached T-F11 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Roland "Whistle" Itswangz watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Roland "Whistle" Itswangz checked the fire step after the shelling. The wall had moved, and the spot where he always put his foot was gone. After the loss of Grey Mill, Roland "Whistle" Itswangz helped stack spare sandbags at T-F11. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Roland "Whistle" Itswangz washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation.
Roland "Whistle" Itswangz learned that the brigadier's Christmas pudding is stored in the cellar at battalion headquarters. He has been making careful drawings.
A loose strip of canvas snapped above Roland "Whistle" Itswangz's bunk. He tied it down and received thanks from six apparently sleeping men.
On a quiet night Roland "Whistle" Itswangz (Concord) and Cyril Drawtoss (Hegemony) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there.
joshmcewen541: Walter Joshmcewen found a place in W-F9 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
ljuliolemosl: Day 10: Jakub Ljuliolemosl reached Q-F8 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.

Jakub Ljuliolemosl mended a split glove with pale thread. One finger now looks like it has been promoted. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Jakub Ljuliolemosl helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
A round went through Jakub Ljuliolemosl's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Marek Himself of the Concord (@mr.fartpants.himself).

Jakub Ljuliolemosl was hit twice at Q-F8, once in the leg and once in the side. The second wound is the bad one. Shot by Benedikt "Owl" Dutch of the Concord (@dutch_1996). A single shot at Q-F8. Jakub Ljuliolemosl sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Benedikt "Owl" Dutch of the Concord (@dutch_1996).
Ulrich Ljuliolemosl arrived carrying the family name of Jakub Ljuliolemosl. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet grazed Ulrich Ljuliolemosl's ribs at Q-F8. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second.
Ulrich Ljuliolemosl walked back up the communication trench to Q-F8, slower than before, but on his own feet.
mon.amourika: Nils Amourika introduced himself as a postman from Rosenau. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.

Nils Amourika was hit in the forearm at P-F1. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Jonas Phosphor of the Concord (@white__phosphor).

The medic cut the last bandage off Nils Amourika's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to P-F1 the same hour. A letter from home reached Nils Amourika before dusk. Nils Amourika read it twice and slept a little easier.
A man asked Nils Amourika to describe Rosenau without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch.
Nils Amourika fired a single round through a crack in the enemy's steel plate, a gap no wider than a finger. Walter Chandlerz was grazed.
panco_cos: Nobody saw Norbert Cos arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in P-F10, and a quiet machine gunner under it.

The gun team argued about who carried the heaviest load. Norbert Cos offered to swap loads. The argument ended at once. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Norbert Cos helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Norbert Cos fired a burst, moved the gun ten yards, and fired again before the enemy could reply. Ivo Abraham was grazed.
A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Norbert Cos aimed a step ahead and fired: Jonas Witcombe, badly wounded.
The gun crews at P-F10 and the next post fired together on a count of five. Caught between the two guns, Leopold "Mole" Naturallefty was badly wounded.
Norbert Cos found water collecting beneath the gun's cover. He sketched a small shelter and took the drawing to the stores.
str8.rotten: Cyril Rotten signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at S-S13 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
Cyril Rotten was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success.
Across the wire at Hill 304, Cyril Rotten of the Hegemony held up a sign: 'How is your coffee?' Quentin "Shadow" Danny of the Concord held up a sign back: 'Worse than yours.'
Cyril Rotten found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.
Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Cyril Rotten shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Cyril Rotten fired at the enemy dawn watch from S-S13. Gustav Mini was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down. A bullet went through Cyril Rotten's upper arm at S-S13 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Lucien "Tin" Wtm of the Concord (@the_e_point_wtm). The clerk counted the names twice. Cyril Rotten is number 457 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Cyril Rotten did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Cyril Rotten spent the day on a stretcher counting the bearers who went past. Forty-three. None of them stopped.
The stretcher Cyril Rotten lay on for so long has a dent the shape of a body. Cyril Rotten is back at S-S13, and someone else is lying in that dent now.
Cyril Rotten borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Gustav Mini was grazed.
Cyril Rotten's menu now circulates before supper. Someone has requested a wine list. The water bucket has been given a vintage.
thecandlemachine: Roland Thecandlemac came up the line with a lucky button and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
thefreakones: On the way to Q-F17, Walter Thefreakones tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.

A bullet went through Walter Thefreakones's sleeve at Q-F17 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Valentin Peebles of the Concord (@miles.peebles). Grey Mill has been won. Walter Thefreakones listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Walter Thefreakones is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.
Walter Thefreakones and Konrad "Owl" Brockolili divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.

A bullet hit Walter Thefreakones's belt buckle at Q-F17 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Casimir "Owl" Lusaka of the Concord (@strikafrom_lusaka).

Machine-gun fire swept Q-F17. Walter Thefreakones took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Bram "Parson" Dumbasian of the Concord (@dumbasian619). Walter Thefreakones was hit at Q-F17 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Bram "Parson" Dumbasian of the Concord (@dumbasian619).
Yann Thefreakones came to the front because his cousin Walter Thefreakones never came home. He carries a stub of a pencil.
